title: The Uniform of Valparaíso
author: Jude Nakamura
blurb: Petra Nystrom, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, keeps a low profile and busy hands. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
